primaryRawText:
Exceptional efficiency: This 80 Plus Gold
and Cybenetics Platinum certified unit can
achieve Titanium level efficiency at 10%
and 20% loads in a 115V test.
Optimized thermal performance: An
anodic-coated heat sink keeps average
component temperatures 5℃ lower than a
traditional heat sink for enhanced
durability and a prolonged life span.
ATX 3.1 support & a durable 12V-2x6
cable: Includes ATX 3.1 support and a 90-
degree 12+4pin (12V-2x6) PCIe 5.1 cable
featuring lower temperatures, enhanced
durability, and improved safety.
Silent fan performance with a zero-RPM
mode: This unit has received a Cybenetics
A- noise level certification and includes a
smart thermal control mode that defaults
to zero spin.
High-quality Japanese capacitors: High-
quality Japanese capacitors feature reduced
ripple noise and enhanced reliability.
Introducing the GX III Gold, featuring an all-new material
and structural design with hexagonal details for
improved airflow and a cleaner overall look. This 80 Plus
Gold and Cybenetics Platinum certified unit can achieve
Titanium level efficiency at light loads in a 115V test.
The GX III Gold also features ATX 3.1 support, a durable
12V-2x6 cable, a half-bridge APFC, LLC, and DC-DC
design, anodic-coated heat sinks that reduce average
component temperature by 5 °C, and an STCM zero-
RPM fan. The GX III Gold achieves excellent performance,
efficiency, noise reduction, and heat dissipation.
STRENGTH IN ELEGANCE
Fully modular cabling: Efficiently reduces clutter,
increases airflow, and improves overall efficiency
and thermal performance.
Innovative, streamlined design: An innovative
screwless aesthetic provides a cleaner
appearance, and the hexagonal fan cover
improves air intake efficiency.
10-year warranty: This unit comes with a
standard limited manufacturing warranty of 10
years from the date of purchase.
